subject: Canada - Argentine Republic ** Approval the proclamation of the entry into force of the Agreement on Social Security Agreement **
precis: Order Directing that a Proclamation be issued to give notice the entry into force of the Agreement on Social Security between Canada and the Argentine Republic, signed in Buenos Aires on August 13, 2021. The Agreement will enter into force on December 1, 2026
